name: Gale
description:
You release a surge of wind that throws the battlefield into disarray. Until the start of your next turn, within medium range of you, movement costs double and all melee and ranged attack rolls made by creatures within the area, or targeting a creature within the area, are ill-favored (skip engagement).

Release (Troubled):

  • + Range

  • Choose one creature within range. It cannot be targeted by attacks.

  • All damage against creatures within range is halved.

Describe the surge of wind.
